{{infobox Chinese|l=Yin Earth Pig|kanji=己亥|romaji=tsuchinoto i|onyomi=kigai|p=jǐhài|w=chi-hai|mi=t͡ɕi³⁵ xaɪ̯|y=gei2 hoi6|j=gei2 hoi6|ci=kei hɐi|mc=kɨj ɣəi|oc-bs=kɯʔ ɢəʔ}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Earth Pig''' (己亥, ''tsuchinoto i''; onyomi ''kigai'') is the 36th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle|1=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 36th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Earth Dog|ja|戊戌|1=Yang Earth Dog}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Metal Rat|ja|庚子|1=Yang Metal Rat}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem|1=Heavenly Stems}} ''己'' is Yin Earth, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch|1=Earthly Branches}} ''亥'' (Pig) is Yin Water; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Earth Pig (己亥)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): jǐhài
** Cantonese (Jyutping): gei2 hoi6
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: tsuchinoto-i
*** On'yomi: kigai
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): gihae (기해)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Kỷ Hợi

==Years of Yin Earth Pig==
A {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era|1=Common Era}} year that leaves a remainder of 39 when divided by 60 is a year of Yin Earth Pig (己亥).

==Months of Yin Earth Pig==
In years where the last digit is 1 or 6 (corresponding to the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem|1=Heavenly Stems}} {{ill|Xin|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin}} or {{ill|Bing|ja|丙|1=Hinoe (丙)|lt=Hinoe (丙)|2=ja|3=丙|4=zh|5=丙|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bing}}), the {{ill|October|en|October|qid=Q124|lt=October|1=October}} of that year is considered a Yin Earth Pig month. However, this applies to the {{ill|Lunisolar calendar|ja|旧暦|1=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar calendar}}, and in some cases, the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term|1=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Lidong|en|Lidong|qid=Q1191018|lt=Lidong|1=Lidong}} to the day before {{ill|Daxue (solar term)|en|Daxue (solar term)|qid=Q337815|lt=Daxue|1=Daxue (solar term)}}) is used.

==Days of Yin Earth Pig==
=== Selection Days ===
Yin Earth Pig days are the 7th day of the {{ill|Ten'ichi Tenjō|ja|天一天上|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ten'ichi Tenjō|ja_comment=天一神|1=Tenitsu-shin|2=ja|3=天一神|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11442153}} cycle.
